intro.title: Form Validation with Zod + React Hook Form
intro.body: In this lesson, you will build a simple user registration form that validates input like email and password. You will learn how to use Zod, a TypeScript-first schema library, to define validation rules. Then, you'll integrate Zod with React Hook Form to manage form state and display validation errors. This approach ensures your form data is type-safe and user-friendly.
intro.usecase: Form validation with Zod and React Hook Form is essential for building robust user interfaces in real-world Angular applications. This pattern appears in registration forms, checkout processes, and data entry dashboards where user input must be validated before submission. For example, e-commerce sites use it to validate shipping addresses and payment information, while admin panels rely on it for creating and editing database records. Developers implement this combination to ensure data integrity, provide immediate user feedback, and reduce server-side validation errors in production applications.
